title: Pentaryn NPC Ties
description: Who knows who. Records directed relationships between actors — a stance, a one-word label, a strength and a page of notes — reads them on a Ties tab on the actor sheet — a reference panel of portraits, words and stances where clicking a row opens it to edit in place — adds them from the map with a key or the token HUD, and shows them on the canvas: hover a token and press the Ties key for a card per person that token knows who is in sight, or the step key for one card at a time through a crowded room with their token art, the word, their name and the notes. Drag a card to keep it; a thin line keeps it wired to whoever it is about. A third key shows a character's own written description instead — GM only. Players can use the tie keys on their own character — only their own connections, only what their token can actually see. Client-side apart from one relay: a player cannot write to an NPC, so their client asks a GM's to record the other half of a tie. Exposes game.pentaryn.ties.
